repos.title: Repositories
repos.description: GitHub repos to check, as "owner/repo" (e.g. "facebook/react"). One release lookup is billed per repo.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: Only return releases published within this many days of today.

includePrereleases.title: Include pre-releases
includePrereleases.description: Include releases marked as pre-release (betas, release candidates) in addition to stable releases.

maxResultsPerRepo.title: Max results per repo
maxResultsPerRepo.description: Maximum number of releases to return per repo, most recent first.

githubToken.title: GitHub token (optional)
githubToken.description: Optional personal access token. Not required for public repos, but raises GitHub's API rate limit from 60 to 5,000 requests/hour if you're checking many repos in one run.
